newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: USDA figures keep lid on feeds trade in Europe.
newsitem.headline: USDA figures keep lid on feeds trade in Europe.

text.p: The European meals and feed market saw a few trades this afternoon as sellers withdrew when Chicago soycomplex futures opened limit up on USDA crop and stocks figures, market sources said.

"Most buyers stayed sidelined on a stronger dollar and problems with shipping material due to frozen inland waterways. After the bullish USDA crop and stocks figures buyers showed up, but the sellers had disappeared," one broker said.
Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets traded at $285 a tonne cif Rotterdam and Jan at $278, $3 above midday's asking price.
